name: Tm Studio
pitch: Shape Qlik data with your own HTML and CSS, ready-made layouts and four independent styles.
question: How can I shape a Qlik view around the story in my data?
useWhen: Design a custom card, list, infographic or data scene
features: 22 chart, card and list types, plus four infographic briefings
Four styles, shared through an app variable or chosen per object
Own HTML and CSS with values, loops, conditions and groups
Selections, keyboard interaction, tooltips and sheet links
Paged lists and checked data loads up to 200,000 rows
AI template prompts and optional scripts in a sealed frame

hero.alt: Regional bars, category columns, grouped monthly columns and a revenue trend in the Native style.
hero.caption: Start from a chart layout and shape it around your data

screenshots.caption: The same charts and data in Signal

screenshots.caption: KPI cards and a hero KPI in Signal

screenshots.caption: Ranked and grouped lists with totals and shares

questions: How can I compare measures in a layout that fits my app?
How can I combine cards, lists and infographics in one data view?
How can viewers select values in a custom template?
audience: Qlik dashboard authors who need custom cards, lists, infographics or data scenes.

featureStrips.heading: Choose a layout and change its style
featureStrips.text: Start from charts, cards and lists, then choose Native, Harbor, Signal or Margin without replacing your HTML and CSS.
featureStrips.alt: KPI cards and a hero revenue card in Margin, using the same data as the Signal cards.

featureStrips.heading: Tell the story with an infographic
featureStrips.text: Combine a total, shares and comparisons in one briefing, or adapt the template for your own measures.
featureStrips.alt: A revenue total and donut beside contribution bars in Margin.

featureStrips.heading: Keep the detail close
featureStrips.text: Build a detailed ledger with measures and small comparison marks, or use a paged table for longer lists.
featureStrips.alt: Regional revenue, target and prior-period measures with small comparison bars in Margin.

featureStrips.heading: Compare steps and shares
featureStrips.text: Use a cumulative waterfall to explain movement, or a treemap to compare each positive contribution with the total.
featureStrips.alt: A signed waterfall beside a product revenue treemap in Signal.
